fields.text: Write original closing-credits lyrics, then hear them sung. One text model writes [Verse]/[Chorus] lyrics from the brief; Mureka Generate Song sings them in the editable musical style. Music step $0.225, plus text. Listen for clear words, melody and fit to the brief; generated duration and precise musical structure can vary.

Write a short original closing-credits song for a night-market game. Last stall of the night: a wok fire dying to coals, red lanterns still lit over wet asphalt, grilled-squid smoke hanging in the lane, one wooden stool left out for the last customer. Theme: packing up is its own kind of care. Warm, cinematic, hopeful — not cute. No brand names, no real artist names.

fields.system: Write original singable lyrics from the brief, maximum 160 words. Plain language, concrete details, natural stresses and a short memorable chorus. Use [Verse 1], [Chorus], [Verse 2], [Chorus], [Outro] labels. Preserve the requested mood and avoid adding named brands or copyrighted lyrics. Output only section labels and lyrics.

fields.text: Late-night analog folk, slow mid-tempo, close dry vocal, fingerpicked nylon guitar, distant wok hiss and bicycle bells under a soft brushed snare. Clear words and a sticky chorus; no artist imitation.
